name: checklists.getDueChecklistPrompts
doc:
Mid-shift prompts (spec 9.2): pending tasks whose window has opened, for today, but only
when prompts_enabled. Returns [] when the flag is off so the FOH prompt component stays
silent.

Excludes `open` and `anytime` (those live on the dedicated screen and have no moment worth
interrupting service for). `close` IS included, but on its own shorter lead: the closing
tasks become visible and tickable an hour before close (close_lead_minutes), and the

Without this the only honest options were to tick something that did not

than decided. `skipped` already existed as a state with a `skip_reason`
column; this is the first thing to write to it from the floor.

the week nothing they did not already know.

these rows; the email that once went out at completion no longer exists), so undoing it
and re-entering an in-range value would erase the breach. The guard sits in the update
itself so a breach can never be cleared, whatever the screen showed.

2026; owner decision D7).

created and confirmed at once with no payment hold, so the guest is never sent "Complete your
payment"; its ticket lines map to the new night's ticket types by name; the guests travel with
their names and phones and the new night's answers; the payments move with the booking; the
original is cancelled with its table; the move is recorded. It used to run as a dozen separate
writes that emailed a payment link, lost ticket types (the deferred seat-sum check refused the
separate delete of ticket lines) and refused named bookings.

A dearer night is refused. On a cheaper night the difference is not promised in a text: it is a
refund request a manager decides, and the manager inbox is told.

name: privateBookingInvoice.cancelPrivateBookingInvoice
doc:
Cancel a booking's invoice so a corrected one can be raised.

The booked items change after invoicing more often than the original design
allowed for, and until this existed there was no way back: the atomic
generate RPC short circuits on `private_bookings.invoice_id`, so a second
press returned the original invoice rather than a corrected one.

This voids the invoice and releases the booking in one database call, so a
failure can never leave a live invoice unlinked or a void one still attached.
The deposit is untouched on the booking and is re-applied when the
replacement invoice is generated.

A real payment blocks this outright. Money received against an invoice is
resolved with a credit note, never by voiding the invoice underneath it.

`changeNote` is required after the first publish.

Only the draft that was checked is published. `draftUploadedAt` (optional) is the draft the
manager previewed: when it is given and the draft has been replaced since, nothing is published.
The freeze itself is also tied to the draft read here, so a draft replaced while this runs is
refused rather than published unchecked.

`draft`) on first upload; replaces the existing draft; stores images in the `training` bucket.

name: training.recordExternalQualification
doc:
training:manage. Records an external qualification as completed. Form fields: employeeId,
courseId, issuer, reference, issuedOn, expiresOn (optional), file (pdf, jpg or png, at most
EXTERNAL_CERTIFICATE_MAX_BYTES, 4 MB: the platform refuses a bigger request, see
src/lib/training/upload-limits.ts).

name: training.recordPracticalSignoff
doc:
training:manage. Records a practical sign-off with the learner beside the manager; returns the
in-person URL the learner confirms on.

The ticked tasks are checked against the version the item is pinned to (the one the sign-off
form lists and the document is made from), or the course's current version for an item not
yet pinned. One `signoff_recorded` log line is written, here, with the manager's note and
whether the sign-off says "Supervised only" (createPracticalSignoff writes none). Once the
sign-off is saved, a failed log line or audit row is logged and the manager is still told it
worked, with the in-person link.

name: training.recordTrainedInPerson
doc:
training:manage. Records training a manager says was given in person before (owner decision,
3 November 2026), so staff trained before the app need not take it again. Each course is
completed on `trainedOn`, with the manager's name, and its refresher is worked out from that
date. An open item on the course is completed; otherwise a completed cycle is added. Nobody
signs anything and nothing is sent to the person.

The rules a sign-off follows still apply, course by course: the minimum age (today and on the
day trained), the course's age group for a new cycle, and the course it needs first, in date.
A course already done and in date, or waiting for the person to confirm it, is left alone.
Each refusal comes back in `skipped`; the rest are still recorded.

name: training.resumeTraining
doc: training:manage. Ends a pause now; each open due date becomes the later of itself and today + 14.

name: training.setTrainingAdjustmentNote
doc:
training:manage. Records the adjustment a person's training uses (for example "read aloud
offered"), at most 300 characters and never a health detail; null clears it.

There is no training event type for this note, so the change is recorded in the audit log only
(without the wording, which stays on the profile).
